code:
# Continuous sync pipeline (UI or SDK)
# Sync Mode: Continuous + declared primary key
# -> 10-15 second lag, Databricks manages it

# Real-time mode via ForeachWriter
from lakebase_foreachwriter import LakebaseForeachWriter
writer = LakebaseForeachWriter(
    table="your_target_table", df=your_dataframe,
    mode="insert", batch_size=1000, batch_interval_ms=100,
)
# -> 200-300ms, you manage the streaming query
caption: A genuine production trade-off: simplicity vs. sub-second freshness.
